mapper.insert: insert into raffle_activity_account_flow(user_id, activity_id, total_count, day_count, month_count, flow_id, flow_channel, biz_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{totalCount}, #{dayCount}, #{monthCount}, #{flowId}, #{flowChannel}, #{bizId})
mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, total_count, day_count, month_count, flow_id, flow_channel, biz_id from raffle_activity_account_flow where user_id = #{userId}
